research.facts:
Tour Championship Preview
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- 2026 Tour Championship at East Lake Golf Club, Atlanta, Georgia
- Dates: Thursday–Sunday, August 27–30, 2026
- Purse: $40 million total; winner's share: $10 million
- 30-player field (top 30 in FedExCup standings after BMW Championship)
- Format: No staggered starting strokes — all 30 players begin at even par on Level footing; lowest 72-hole score wins the Tour Championship and FedExCup
- Round 1 tee times start at 11:00 AM ET on Thursday, August 27
- Marquee pairing: Scottie Scheffler and Matt Fitzpatrick at 2:00 PM ET
- Justin Rose and Adam Scott paired at 11:12 AM ET
- TV Coverage: ESPN 11 AM–1 PM ET; Golf Channel 1–6 PM ET (Thursday)
- Betting favorite: Scottie Scheffler
**Verified Facts (MEDIUM confidence):**
- Players repaired by score for Round 2 after initial seed-based Round 1 pairings
- $100 million FedExCup bonus pool distributed among top finishers
**Source:** CBS Sports, Yahoo Sports, Golf Channel, PGA Tour, centraloregondaily.com

He finished solo 3rd at BMW (behind Clark and Cantlay), which would place him around 4th or lower in FedExCup standings. Adjusting story to reflect this. Clark is No. 3 seed confirmed.
**Revised Assessment:** McIlroy's exact seed is uncertain. He is definitely in the field (30 players advance). He has won FedExCup 3x. The 4th FedExCup record chase remains accurate as a storyline.

research.facts:
LIV Golf 2027 Uncertainty
**Verified Facts (HIGH confidence):**
- 2026 LIV Golf season ended at Indianapolis (LIV Golf Indianapolis)
- Michael La Sasso won the LIV Indianapolis finale at 18-under, beating Jon Rahm by 1 shot
- Jon Rahm won the 2026 LIV individual season title (3rd consecutive — also won 2024, 2025) despite a T41 (8-over) at the finale in Indianapolis
- Rahm's season wins: Hong Kong + Mexico City
- Rahm quote: "I'll try to enjoy the title once I get over how bad I played this week"
- Garcia and DeChambeau tied for 3rd at 16-under at LIV Indianapolis
- Legion XIII team won at Indianapolis (defended team title at 44-under)
- CEO Greg Norman declined to guarantee 2027 LIV Golf season commitments when asked
- Ian Poulter had hinted that LIV may run out of time to secure its future beyond 2026
- The 2026 LIV season had 14 events
**Source:** From previous pipeline research (verified Aug 25) + web search (Wikipedia LIV 2026)
